subject: planner: Fix bug in the plan cache when the metadata lock is disabled. (#64795)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent. The change renames `StmtCtx.MDLRelatedTableIDs` to `StmtCtx.RelatedTableIDs`, initializes/clears it per statement, and records table IDs even when `tidb_enable_metadata_lock=off` (via `tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary`’s defer). This ensures prepared plan cache retains the statement’s table list under MDL-disabled mode so plan-cache preprocessing can still perform schema/dirty-table handling. No Blocker/High correctness, concurrency, transaction/session, or visibility issues found in the touched planner/executor/sessionctx paths; later history scan shows no subsequent fixes specifically adjusting this new table-ID tracking behavior.
